Is this therapy?

No. It’s expert-led coaching and practice in a community. It isn’t a replacement for therapy, and plenty of members do both.

Do I have to share?

No. Camera off is fine, and you’re welcome to just listen. Share when you’re ready.

What if I can’t make it live?

Love Masterminds are recorded, so you can catch them later from anywhere.

How do I cancel?

On your own, anytime, from your billing page. We email you before your 14 free days end.
